final: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) AS total_invoices, (SELECT COUNT(i2.invoice_number) * 1.0 / ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoices) * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Orders)) FROM Orders o2 LEFT JOIN Invoices i2 ON i2.order_id = o2.order_id) AS average_share FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id) WHERE invoice_count * 1.0 / total_invoices > average_share
